column5: The sole __DATA,__data pointer to the NSConstantString with bytes "org.brautaset.JSON.ErrorDomain" in each slice, matching the upstream variable initializer.

+[GAD_SBJSON initialize] builds the 34-byte scanner character table starting four bytes past this address by writing quote, backslash, control characters 1 through 31, and NUL. appendString:into:error: uses the adjacent object pointer for its escape character set.

Shared helper called with an error code, NSError **, and explanatory string from scanRestOfArray:error:, scanRestOfDictionary:error:, scanRestOfString:error: and scanUnicodeChar:error:. Its message sends build an NSError with NSUnderlyingErrorKey.
Function pointer passed to SCNetworkReachabilitySetCallback by -[GADNetworkChecker startNetworkChecking]. The callback sends setNetworkTypeFromFlags: to the context object.
+[GADCachedFile formatterForHTTPDate] stores its newly allocated NSDateFormatter in this slot and sends setDateFormat:, setLocale: and setTimeZone: to the same object.
+[GADNetworkChecker sharedChecker] passes this slot to dispatch_once and returns the adjacent object filled by the once block.
The dyld-bound global block used by +[GADNetworkChecker sharedChecker] stores this invoke function in its fourth word. It allocates the singleton and enables checking.
+[GADTiming counter] tests this dispatch_once predicate before reading its cached conversion factor.
The counter initialization block stores a double here after mach_timebase_info. +[GADTiming counter] multiplies this value by mach_absolute_time().
The dyld-bound global block used by +[GADTiming counter] stores this invoke function in its fourth word. It divides the Mach timebase ratio by one billion.
+[GADNetworkUtilities userAgentString] returns the object at this address. The HTTP-date parser retains its three formatters at offsets 4, 8 and 12 from that same base.
The helper shared by all three format paths in +[GADNetworkUtilities dateFromHttpDateString:] configures an NSDateFormatter with the en_US locale, GMT and the caller's format string.
+[GADURLConnection memoryCache] passes this dispatch_once predicate to libdispatch and returns the adjacent NSCache, initialized with a count limit of 25 by its block.
The dyld-bound global block used by +[GADURLConnection memoryCache] stores this invoke function in its fourth word. The block allocates the NSCache and sets its count limit to 25.
